$doc: Vyomi capability registry — GCP Resource Manager (the 'Manage resources' page). See aws/s3.json for the contract. GCP/Azure claims have no AWS-wire probe — they are proven by 'tests' (conformance files run against the in-process router).

gcp.resource-manager.delete-project.title: Delete project
limitations: Vyomi deletes the project immediately. Real GCP soft-deletes a project for a 30-day recovery window (with an Undelete action) before it is purged for good; Vyomi has no recoverable-deleted-project state to restore from.

gcp.resource-manager.move-project.title: Move project (change parent folder/organization)
limitations: Vyomi's GCP lens is project-scoped: it models no organizations or folders, so there is no resource hierarchy to move a project into.
